{
  "thinking": "Blank table, 10 minutes. A fish has an outline anyone can read, and the tail fin makes it obvious. I'll claim the pad and sketch it so we can all see the plan.",
  "say": "Let's do a fish. The tail fin makes it obvious from the outline alone. I'm sketching it now, start at the tail end and we run along the top and bottom.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 8,
  "point": [4, 10],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type":"label","x":4,"y":11,"text":"START"},
    {"type":"curve","points":[[4,10],[9,6],[16,5],[22,8],[25,10]]},
    {"type":"curve","points":[[25,10],[22,12],[16,15],[9,14],[4,10]]},
    {"type":"curve","points":[[9,6],[6,3],[5,10],[9,14]]},
    {"type":"circle","cx":20,"cy":9,"r":0.7},
    {"type":"label","x":20,"y":7,"text":"eye"}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Plan: fish. Stroke 1 = top edge from START (tail end) to nose. Stroke 2 = bottom edge back to START. Stroke 3 = tail fin branching off the body. Stroke 4 = eye. I hold the pad for now; I'll trace strokes 1-2 once Tom or Priya takes the rest."
}
